fit_reason: Whole car, a 2011 Crown Victoria sedan listed by a private owner in the cars by owner section.
findings: Yellowed, hazy headlight lenses on both front headlights

message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Crown Vic. The headlights look pretty yellowed and the black paint on the hood and trunk has gone dull in the photos, and both of those clean up well. We do mobile pre-sale details, including headlight restoration, a buff and wax, and an interior clean that can help with the seat stains. Would you like a quote?
